resources.name: custom-ansible-unit-fixture-parser
resources.yaml_template:
$schema: https://schemas.humio.com/parser/v0.3.0
name: custom-ansible-unit-fixture-parser
fieldsToBeRemovedBeforeParsing: []
testCases: []
script: |-
    parseJson()
    | Cps.version := "1.0.0"
    | Vendor := "ansible"
    | ecs.version := "9.0.0"
    | event.dataset := "ansible.fixture"
    | event.kind := "event"
    | event.module := "ansible"
    | event.outcome := "success"
    | observer.type := "test"
tagFields:
    - Cps.version
    - Vendor
    - ecs.version
    - event.dataset
    - event.kind
    - event.module
    - event.outcome
    - observer.type
